title: The Bigger Picture
intent: Maintain continuous awareness of the largest coherent frame so that daily actions remain aligned with long-term generative goals.
eta_goal: Prevent local optimization from becoming global entropy increase.
core_framing: Every local decision either serves or undermines the larger movement toward ordered complexity and resonance with Source.
The bigger picture includes thermodynamic, ethical, and spiritual continuity.
OpenRoot exists as one concrete expression of that larger movement.
optimized_query_patterns: How does this immediate choice affect the multi-year trajectory of useful joules and coherence?
What would the highest-η version of this situation look like from a ten-year perspective?
constraints: Must remain actionable, not merely contemplative
verification_notes: Consistency between daily actions and stated long-term direction.
next_physical_or_action: Review one recurring decision pattern against the ten-year generative goal.
